roles.title: Junior Reporting Analyst
roles.draft_decision: Proceed with a supported role-fit draft; retain partial Excel evidence and unconfirmed property interest in the evaluation.
roles.eligibility: Plausible fit; mandatory competency coverage is partly evidenced, with no demonstrated disqualifier.
roles.strongest_fit: Professional source reconciliation, finance-dashboard delivery, recurring reporting, stakeholder requirements and rapid platform learning directly address the reporting function.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: English communication
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Fluent English and professional stakeholder communication are registered.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Excel competence
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Excel is an established source in professional reconciliation and candidate dashboards. This supports Excel exposure, but does not establish independent spreadsheet proficiency or particular formulas. Confirm a concrete workbook task; do not label advanced Excel.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Basic financial/operational report understanding
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Finance dashboard construction and access-tracking reconciliation support reporting understanding. The reconciliation project concerns access requests, not ledger balances, rent accounts or financial-statement preparation.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Cross-checking, organisation and reliability
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Source discrepancy tracing, testing and 300+ reports over six months provide examples. They do not establish zero errors or perfect SLA performance.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Analytical mindset and interest in property/alternative investment
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Analytical work is supported. Personal property/investment motivation is not registered and must come from the candidate; do not fabricate it.

preferred_gaps: Yardi Voyager 7S, AccountsIQ, property/CRM systems and Notion proficiency are not registered. These are preferences or named tools, not a mandatory prior-property-employment rule.

Accounting principles, bookkeeping, specific Office/Google Workspace proficiency and API/no-code integration experience are not established. Power BI and general SQL are supported; Python/R are academic.
AI is optional. Do not force restricted GenAI-project wording into a property reporting resume merely to include the keyword.

selected_projects.rationale: Closest analogue to cross-checking multiple sources and tracing reporting discrepancies.
selected_projects.boundary: Professional team project about access tracking; preserve co-development and the reported baseline.

selected_projects.rationale: Finance reporting and a reusable dashboard template align with recurring reports, feedback and new reporting tools.
selected_projects.boundary: Built from a client wireframe on a proprietary BI platform; effort savings are candidate-reported, not independently measured.

roles.selection_note: PROJ-NIQ-REPORTING is the next strongest alternative and should remain prominent in Professional Experience for reporting volume, requirements and two-week learning. The selected POC adds distinct finance-reporting evidence.
exact_evidence_needed: Candidate example of hands-on Excel work: inputs, cross-checks, formulas or pivot/filter methods actually used, output and personal contribution. A sanitised workbook or walkthrough would substantiate competence.
Candidate explanation of interest in property/alternative investment and willingness to undertake bookkeeping, operations and IT-administration duties.
Confirm Dublin 8 in-person availability; inspect the actual application instructions when accessible.
roles.release_readiness: Not release-ready. The employer JD is verified, but the exact Indeed route returned Additional Verification Required. Application instructions/form gates remain unverified; resume compilation, mapping and visual QA are separate outstanding steps.
roles.gateway: Additional Verification Required on exact employer-linked Indeed posting; do not bypass verification.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.draft_decision: Proceed with a supported role-fit draft and prioritise because the posting closes 16 September 2026.
roles.eligibility: Strong transferable BI/operational-data fit. The advertised alternatives do not require prior engineering employment in addition to operational-data experience.
roles.strongest_fit: Multi-source access operations reporting, Power BI modelling/delivery, stakeholder handover and refresh automation match project-data validation and accessible KPI reporting.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Relevant technical bachelor degree, including computer science
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Candidate-supplied B.Tech Computer Science (AI and ML) meets the subject requirement; no honours equivalence should be invented.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Engineering projects OR operational data OR technical/industrial experience
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Professional access-tracking operations and reporting delivery support the operational-data route. No maintenance-engineering employment is claimed.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: BI, KPI/performance analysis
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Professional dashboard/data-model delivery plus visible candidate KPI reporting. Maintenance-specific performance measures are a learning area.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Interpret and validate complex multi-source data
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Five-source consolidation, discrepancy drill-through and validation are direct evidence.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Communication, requirements, adaptability and learning
mandatory_requirements.assessment: BRDs, two-week platform learning, executive demonstration and handover are registered.

preferred_gaps: Relevant postgraduate study is supported by EDU-MSC-001, but the MSc award remains in progress. Do not present an awarded masters.
Industrial maintenance/reliability domain expertise is not established. PROJ-SECOM-FAULT-DETECTION provides academic manufacturing exposure, not operational engineering employment.

DAX and Power Apps appear in duties without an explicit proficiency threshold. They remain unverified development areas, not automatic knockout requirements. SharePoint is supported as a reconciliation source, not full SharePoint application/workflow development. Power Automate refresh work is supported by WORK-AZ-OTHER-001.

selected_projects.rationale: Directly addresses multi-source operational data, traceable discrepancy checks and accessible Power BI reporting.
selected_projects.boundary: Co-developed access-tracking solution; not engineering-asset maintenance or accounts reconciliation.

selected_projects.rationale: Shows data modelling, end-to-end Power BI delivery, demonstration and stakeholder handover within a stated time window.
selected_projects.boundary: One contributor in a three-person team; exact KPI definitions and commercial causality are not established.

roles.selection_note: PROJ-SECOM-FAULT-DETECTION ranks behind the two professional BI examples: it adds academic industrial context but is less similar to recurring operational/project reporting. If used elsewhere, retain one-split and low failure-class F1 limitations. PROJ-POWERBI-PORTFOLIO can support KPI visibility in the comparison without replacing stronger professional delivery evidence.
exact_evidence_needed: Confirm Limerick office-based availability and start availability.
If the form asks about DAX, Power Apps or SharePoint development, use only actual examples; seek candidate confirmation/artifacts before adding such proficiency to the registry.
Inspect login-gated application requirements and any actual work-permission questions. The generic permit notice is not evidence of a Stamp 1G exclusion or sponsorship promise.
roles.release_readiness: Not release-ready. The full JD and account gateway were observed, but account-gated instructions/form requirements have not been traversed. Complete truthful tailoring, evidence mapping, two-page compilation and visual QA before releasing a reviewed artifact.
roles.gateway: JobsIreland login/register gateway untraversed; no application entered.

roles.title: Data Analyst - Contract
roles.draft_decision: A truthful provisional draft is useful, but retain mandatory advanced Excel coverage as unresolved; do not mark fully eligible or release-ready.
roles.eligibility: Strong reconciliation/data-quality overlap with one clear mandatory evidence gap: advanced Excel. No evidence of inability, but current evidence cannot establish the required level.
roles.strongest_fit: Five-source reconciliation, discrepancy traceability, access controls and stakeholder reporting are closely related to the advertised contract work.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Proven analysis, data quality and reconciliation
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Source consolidation, discrepancy tracing, testing and validation; do not equate access requests with financial ledger reconciliation.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Advanced Excel with Power BI/Tableau/SAP or similar
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Power BI/Tableau are supported, but Excel-source use does not establish advanced spreadsheet methods. SAP is not established; do not treat every listed BI tool as separately mandatory.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Complex multi-source data
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Five access-tracking sources provide a concrete professional example.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Understanding compliance, governance, controls OR audit
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Access request traceability, discrepancies and Power BI membership administration support a controls/governance analogue. This is not financial audit employment, regulatory compliance ownership or certified accounting expertise.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Stakeholder communication, organisation and priorities
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Requirements, high-volume delivery and timed team handover are supported; formal SLAs and root-cause methodology are not documented.

preferred_gaps: Finance/accounting background is advantageous. Finance BI/access reconciliation is relevant; bookkeeping, ledger reconciliation and accounting credentials are not established.
Employer client is undisclosed. No client sector, regulatory regime or technology estate should be inferred from recruiter branding.

selected_projects.rationale: Closest match to reconciliation, multi-source quality checks, source traceability and controls.
selected_projects.boundary: Access-governance reconciliation, co-developed in a team; no audit/ledger or advanced Excel claim.

selected_projects.rationale: Adds sustained report delivery, requirements translation, client communication and learning unfamiliar systems.
selected_projects.boundary: 300+ reports over six months; no unsupported SLA, defect rate or solo-delivery claim.

roles.selection_note: PROJ-AZ-MIGRATION is a credible third option for collection-to-reporting change, but does not itself prove data-quality or Excel controls. A compliance RAG project would not establish professional audit/governance capability.
exact_evidence_needed: Advanced Excel: an actual work or project example, personal contribution, workbook scale/structure, exact methods used (for example lookups, SUMIFS, PivotTables or Excel Power Query only if true), reconciliation/error-check approach and resulting output. A sanitised workbook or concrete walkthrough should support the claimed level; do not require VBA unless the employer does.

Controls/governance detail: describe one access discrepancy/control, how source records were traced, who reviewed/resolved it and which steps Chetan performed. Existing evidence supports the narrow controls analogy; stronger financial audit/compliance claims need separate evidence.
Confirm Cork attendance two to three days weekly, availability for the 12-month contract and answers to any actual work-permission question when the form is accessible.
roles.release_readiness: Not release-ready. Mandatory advanced Excel remains unverified. Automatic approval review blocked opening Apply Now; actual gateway requirements are unknown. No workaround or submission is authorised by this comparison.
roles.gateway: Apply Now opening blocked by automatic approval review; do not infer form contents.

roles.title: Graduate Programme - Controlling & Analytics
roles.draft_decision: Keep as an eligibility-check lead. Supported analytics content can form a provisional draft, but defer full tailoring priority until objective degree/licence/mobility requirements are resolved.
roles.eligibility: Multiple genuine mandatory requirements are unverified: 2.1 Honours Level 8 eligibility, full driving licence and willingness to travel/relocate. This is uncertainty, not a confirmed rejection.
roles.strongest_fit: Retail/e-commerce sales and profit KPI communication plus executive Power BI handover transfer to business insights and controlling rotations.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Expected or attained 2.1 Honours Level 8 degree
mandatory_requirements.assessment: B.Tech CGPA 9.4/10 is supplied but no Irish classification/equivalence is established. MSc Semester 1 2:1 is not the final award or automatic proof of the specified bachelor eligibility.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Full driving licence
mandatory_requirements.assessment: No registered licence evidence; do not assume from country, age or professional experience.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Flexibility to travel and relocate within Ireland
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Ireland location and general preferred cities do not establish relocation/travel commitment.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Analytical/numeracy skills and accurate KPI reporting
mandatory_requirements.assessment: E-commerce KPIs, discrepancy checks and academic quantitative methods are supported.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Communication and deadline delivery under pressure
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Stakeholder delivery and time-bounded projects support the requirement; do not invent crisis/pressure anecdotes.

mandatory_requirements.requirement: Motivation and programme availability from 6 September 2027 for 18 months
mandatory_requirements.assessment: Motivation for retail rotations, store/distribution training and the future start require the candidate response. No graduation, availability or permission coverage can be inferred from elapsed time.

preferred_gaps: German is advantageous, not required; LANG-001 lists English, Tamil and Telugu. Its absence is not a hard blocker.
No particular analytics software is mandatory. Do not add a DAX/Excel/SAP screening requirement absent from the verified JD.
Financial controlling or retail employment is not established; transferable finance/retail analytics examples remain usable.

selected_projects.rationale: Closest retail KPI analogue: visible e-commerce sales, profit, quantity, shipping and geography reporting.
selected_projects.boundary: Candidate portfolio, not retail employment; no undocumented DAX, data model, deployment or business impact.

selected_projects.rationale: Professional senior-stakeholder dashboard delivery complements the retail KPI example and maps to decision support from operational teams to leadership.
selected_projects.boundary: Three-person team; do not claim Lidl-like margin, stock-loss or productivity metrics in this dashboard without evidence.

roles.selection_note: PROJ-AZ-RECON is the next strongest accuracy/controls analogue; PROJ-NIQ-POC adds finance reporting, but neither is as close to retail KPI content as the selected portfolio.
exact_evidence_needed: Degree: degree certificate/transcript and a supported classification/equivalence or employer confirmation that the B.Tech 9.4/10 meets its 2.1 Honours Level 8 requirement. Do not self-convert CGPA.
Licence: candidate confirmation of holding a full licence, issuing country/category and any employer-required validity details. Learner status cannot be relabelled full.
Mobility: explicit willingness/ability to travel and relocate within Ireland and undertake store/distribution-centre training.
Availability: explicit ability to start 6 September 2027 and complete the 18-month programme; candidate motivation for this retail/controlling route.

Inspect the actual application form for work-permission and other eligibility questions. WORKAUTH-STAMP-001 confirms only the supplied Stamp 1G fact on 5 September 2026; future duration/sponsorship are unconfirmed.
roles.release_readiness: Not release-ready. Objective eligibility remains unresolved and the linked application form has not been opened. Deadline is 31 October 2026; start is 6 September 2027. No application or related mail invitation is a submission.
roles.gateway: Employer easyapply link visible but form untraversed.
